description: Add CLOSEREASON, CLOSEDAT and CLOSEDBY_ID (FK to WEBUSER) to CREDITCOMPANYCLAIM if missing
author: Dr M H B Ariyaratne
preRequisites: Run migration.sql by hand on the database BEFORE deploying a build that maps CreditCompanyClaim.closeReason, closedAt and closedBy. The migration page only gets this file in that same build, so it cannot run this step first.
Without these columns every claim load fails (claim page, claim list, settlement and cancel updates).
Idempotent; changes no data. Requires the v2.26.0 tables.
rollbackNotes: rollback.sql drops the foreign key, then CLOSEDBY_ID, CLOSEDAT and CLOSEREASON. Close reasons, times and users are lost.
